plugins.name: random-claude-skills
plugins.description: Three skills for working with Claude Code: context-budgeted subagent delegation (fanout), driving your own logged-in Chrome (my-chrome), and running a task to completion without check-in pauses (autopilot).

plugins.description: Run an agentic engineering team: team-lead routing by cost of being wrong, agent-ready task packets, verify-against-reality before done, and guard hooks (no git add -A, no gh pr merge, no force-push, worktree-confined writes, DoD stop gate).
